versions.summary_en: Initial public 14B text, 14B code, and 7B multimodal target contract.
versions.summary_zh: 首次发布 14B 文本、14B 代码和 7B 多模态公开固定靶契约。

versions.summary_en: Adds a dedicated GLM-4.7-Flash 30B-A3B, two-chip, 131K production-trace profile for BurstGPT and TraceLab only.
versions.summary_zh: 新增仅供 BurstGPT 与 TraceLab 使用的 GLM-4.7-Flash 30B-A3B、双卡、131K 生产轨迹官方靶。

versions.summary_en: Hardens production-trace targets with exact source and model revisions, variable-length cohort semantics, and replay evidence binding.
versions.summary_zh: 强化生产轨迹靶：固定源码与模型 revision，采用变长 cohort 语义，并绑定完整回放证据。

versions.summary_en: Pins the reproducible Transformers runtime recipe required by GLM-4.7-Flash production-trace targets.
versions.summary_zh: 固定 GLM-4.7-Flash 生产轨迹靶所需的可复现 Transformers 运行时配方。

versions.summary_en: Migrates GLM-4.7-Flash production-trace targets to the smoke-verified official vLLM-Ascend v0.22.1rc1 OpenEuler image pinned by digest.
versions.summary_zh: 将 GLM-4.7-Flash 生产轨迹靶迁移到已通过 smoke 验证、按摘要固定的官方 vLLM-Ascend v0.22.1rc1 OpenEuler 镜像。

versions.summary_en: Pins the Ascend compilation compatibility setting required by the immutable v0.22.1rc1 image when AddRmsNormBias is unavailable.
versions.summary_zh: 固定不可变 v0.22.1rc1 镜像在缺少 AddRmsNormBias 时所需的 Ascend 编译兼容配置。

versions.summary_en: Pins and attests the upstream batch-invariant compatibility mode required by the immutable v0.22.1rc1 image for production-trace execution.
versions.summary_zh: 固定并证明不可变 v0.22.1rc1 镜像执行生产轨迹所需的上游 batch-invariant 兼容模式。

versions.summary_en: Replaces the incompatible GLM MoE production-trace target with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B on the immutable official runtime, pinning its supported batch-invariant PIECEWISE compilation path and disabling unsupported norm-quant fusion.
versions.summary_zh: 将不兼容的 GLM MoE 生产轨迹靶替换为不可变官方运行时上的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B，固定其受支持的 batch-invariant PIECEWISE 编译路径，并关闭不受支持的 norm-quant 融合。

versions.summary_en: Registers exact SimLLM random-online and saturated-throughput warm-cache A/B targets with pinned source commits and immutable runtime provenance; no local reference measurements are promoted as official results.
versions.summary_zh: 注册精确的 SimLLM random-online 与 saturated-throughput warm-cache A/B 靶，固定源码提交和不可变运行时来源；不将本地参考测量提升为官方结果。

versions.summary_en: Pins a six-hour per-request timeout in the TraceLab production-trace contract so long-tail coding-agent outputs are reproducible and cannot silently inherit a short client default.
versions.summary_zh: 在 TraceLab 生产轨迹契约中固定单请求六小时超时，确保长尾 coding-agent 输出可复现且不会静默继承过短的客户端默认值。

versions.summary_en: Pins SHA-256 prefix-cache hashing for both SimLLM targets so the immutable runtime does not depend on an undeclared xxhash package.
versions.summary_zh: 为两个 SimLLM 靶固定 SHA-256 前缀缓存哈希，避免不可变运行时依赖未声明的 xxhash 包。
